Variants.Content: Deepwood Motte is located on the edge of Wolfwood in the western part of the North and is the traditional seat of House Glover. The real walls here are not just stones, but also boundless coniferous forests, illegible hunting trails, and people familiar with the snow. The wolf forest provides wood, furs, prey and hiding places, and also slows down the supply, communication and pursuit of the army. Deepwood Motte thus assumes the responsibility of guarding the western roads of the North and connecting the coast with the interior. The vassal obligations of the Glover family connect it to Winterfell, but local life is more determined by woods, seasons, and villages near and far. Deepwood Motte's geographical character as the gateway to Wolfwood will not disappear with it.

Entry Deepwood Motte Local families also rely on firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries to survive the long winter; if any road, well, spring, or wharf fails, the price will fall on them first.

Entry Deepwood Motte If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Deepwood Motte A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Deepwood Motte They care about firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries that can survive the long winter. They also care about whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, they see whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
